attackers_goals: An attacker may attempt to gain unauthorized access by leveraging valid credentials found in Google Drive.
description: A user accessed a large volume of files potentially containing credentials in Google Drive.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection
investigative_actions: Check for signs of account compromise, such as abnormal login activity or unusual behavior. Verify if the user account that accessed the files is authorized to access them. Review the files accessed and whether it was part of a breach or a legitimate activity. Monitor the account for any further suspicious actions.
